title: One native CPU FP32 optimizer step on a faithful source record
question: Can the unchanged native training loss backward and optimizer update execute numerically on one complete protected development reading?
method: Strict already-validated raw positive target, offline exact checkpoint, native fullFP32 CPU trainer with max_steps1 and observing forward/optimizer hooks; isolated final checkpoint.
conclusion: Exactly one actual forward/backward/AdamW update completes CPUFP32 with finite loss/allgradients/finalparameters;302parameter tensors changed (weight decay included). One preselected smallest complete formula positive only; no injection-off candidate assessment, model efficacy, no-record specificity, calibration, heldout or product adoption. Native final checkpoint is isolated and original model remains unchanged. Process-tree samples are bounded observations, not aggregate capacity qualification.
